description: 'Třináctá hodina' (The Thirteenth Hour): a 2:45 Halloween song in D minor built from horror-music tropes. A clock strikes twelve on D (Danse macabre), an out-of-tune music-box lullaby, a 5/4 ostinato with heartbeat and chromatic lament bass, an oom-pa-pa skeleton waltz with theremin, harpsichord and woodblock bones, the Dies irae chant on organ and choir, an accelerando chase, a false ending, the music box winding down... and the clock striking thirteen. Meters 4/4, 3/4, 5/4; tempo ramps; automation of the music box's warble and the theremin's glide.

args.title: Třináctá hodina
args.comment: Hodiny odbijí dvanáct, tančí se, zpívá se Dies irae, hrací skříňka dohraje... a pak hodiny odbijí třináctou.
